P1.findings_md: Exchange Bank positions above peers in Strategy & Governance (P1: 2.59 vs median 2.40) and at peer level in Customer Experience (P2: 2.33 vs 2.25). It positions below peers in Operations & Risk (P3: 2.17 vs 2.75) and Data & Technology (P4: 1.99 vs 2.25). This pattern — strong organizational capability with weak technology platforms — defines the Salesforce opportunity.

narrative.recommendations_md: Eight recommendations are presented in priority order, organized into three transformation phases. Each recommendation follows the mandatory structure: ROOT CAUSE (with evidence IDs confirming the gap) → SOLUTION (with named Zennify product) → EXPECTED OUTCOMES. Every recommendation is validated against Exchange Bank’s strategic objectives and identifies a named executive champion from Clay research.
